Eat in, take out

North Indian, tandoor, biryani, Chinese, pizza and pasta, and desserts from churros to waffles. Book a table in the garden or indoors, or order takeaway here: pick your dishes, choose a pickup time, and your order goes straight to our WhatsApp.

Order takeaway

Dinner thatruns intothe night

The Olive Court is a family restaurant on Mall Road with a green outdoor garden and a comfortable indoor hall. Come for lunch with the family, stay for dinner under the lights, and on DJ Nights the garden turns into Amritsar's favourite evening out.

See the garden

Garden moments

Follow us

Eleven to eleven

From the first lunch order to the last song on DJ Nights, the garden changes with the clock.

  1. 11:00–15:00

    Lunch

    Dal, curries, biryani and fresh naan from the tandoor. Family tables indoors, or the garden in the shade.

  2. 15:00–18:00

    Snacks

    Fries, shakes, pizza and pasta for the afternoon crowd, and takeaway ready when you arrive.

  3. 18:00–20:00

    Garden hour

    The lights come on in the garden. Tandoori starters and mocktails under the trees.

  4. 20:00–23:00

    Dinner

    The full menu, indoors or out. Book ahead for the garden on weekends.

  5. Selected nights

    DJ Nights

    A DJ in the garden, music and lights. Follow us to hear about the next one.

Garden& indoors

The real The Olive Court floor plan: private cabins along the wall, round tables in a hedged garden, a DJ platform in the corner, and a lounge with a long table beside the kitchen.

  • Private cabins

    4 cabins, two sofas facing a table in each

  • The garden

    6 round tables of four inside the hedge

  • DJ platform

    Decks and two speakers in the top corner

  • Indoor room & reception

    Two tables of four, a table for two, the reception desk

  • Lounge

    Long table with 3 sofas and 8 stools, plus 3 booths

  • Entrance path

    Brick path from the gate to reception
